observedBoundary: The failure occurred after seed, runtime-image, cache-preparation, container-create, mount inspection, and all other task offline jobs passed.
likelyCause: The previous harness rewrote each dependency root as a symlink from /workspace to /cache. For Immich's pnpm workspace, that changes the original workspace-relative node_modules topology and can fail during Vitest module resolution before the public tests execute.
supportingFacts: The fixed Immich seed uses packages/cli/vite.config.ts with the public command ./node_modules/.bin/vitest --run src/commands/asset.spec.ts.

The prepared Immich cache archive contains packages/cli/node_modules/@immich/sdk -> ../../../sdk, while the cache roots contain packages/sdk/build and packages/sdk/node_modules but not a packages/sdk source root.

Under the previous /workspace/packages/cli/node_modules -> /cache/packages/cli/node_modules rewrite, that pnpm link resolves to /cache/sdk; under the original workspace topology it resolves to /workspace/packages/sdk from the seed.
The Vite runtime resolves its default cache and temporary paths below node_modules, so the measured harness must preserve the workspace package topology while keeping the cache source read-only.
The failed positive-output was intentionally sanitized by the previous harness and therefore cannot distinguish module resolution from another public-smoke failure.

cacheTopology.previousCliNodeModulesResolution: /cache/sdk (not present in the prepared cache roots)

repairAction: Mount each prepared cache root read-only at its matching /workspace path, use disposable placeholders only for missing negative-test roots, and retain distinct sanitized smoke failure markers plus public-test stderr.
claimBoundary: Triage and harness repair rationale only; no G1 readiness, dependency-cache success, public-test success, Pilot, scoring, or benchmark acceptance claim.
